Mumbai's construction sites, port zones, and industrial estates keep up a constant demand for fast, weatherproof temporary offices and site accommodations. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures porta cabins in IS 2062 MS hollow-section frames and despatches them from our Greater Noida factory — reaching Mumbai and the MMR in 3 to 5 days. Whether you need a single-room site office at Navi Mumbai's JNPT corridor, a labour colony block at Thane Creek, or a security guard cabin at a Dharavi redevelopment site, we build to your exact size and specification. Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your requirement.

SAMAN porta cabins are built at our Greater Noida facility and dispatched to Mumbai in 3–5 days.

Why Buyers in Mumbai Choose SAMAN

Mumbai's project timelines move fast. Delays cost money. A factory-built porta cabin from SAMAN arrives ready to use — foundation anchor bolts down, electrical points wired, door and window frames fitted. There is no on-site brick work, no curing time.

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications. We also carry NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Our company started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). Over 500 projects delivered across India.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Transit: 3–5 days from our Greater Noida facility to the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Return policy: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Mumbai's Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Mumbai drives demand from sectors that no other Indian city matches at this scale:

Port and logistics: JNPT (Nhava Sheva), Mumbai Port Trust, and the Logistics Parks along the Eastern Freeway create constant need for portable site offices and security cabins that can be repositioned as operations shift.

Real estate and construction: Dharavi redevelopment, Bandra-Kurla Complex expansion, and metro rail construction (Lines 2A, 7, 9) generate high demand for labour colony structures and contractor offices near active sites.

MIDC zones: Mahad MIDC, Taloja MIDC (PIN 410208), and Turbhe MIDC house hundreds of manufacturing units that regularly need porta cabins for security posts, temporary stores, and quality-check rooms at gate entries.

Film and events: Mumbai's production studios and large outdoor event venues often need quick-deploy porta cabins as production offices, green rooms, and on-site management units.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida and route via NH-48 / NH-19 logistics corridors, Mumbai receives cabins on the same schedule as our Delhi NCR porta cabin supply — no premium freight, no re-routing delays.

Porta Cabin Specifications

Our MS porta cabins are built to last in Mumbai's humidity and monsoon conditions.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections, welded and anchor-bolt mounted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm thick PUF sandwich panels or cement-board options (cement board recommended for coastal and high-humidity zones like Mumbai's waterfront areas).

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheets with an inner false ceiling layer for thermal comfort. Optional turbo ventilators for hot-season airflow.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate.

Doors and windows: MS frame with powder-coat finish. Standard windows are louvre/sliding type; fixed glazing is available on request.

Electrical: Pre-wired with MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, and an earth leakage circuit breaker.

Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes on order.

Configurations: single room, double room, multi-room modular blocks, cabin with attached toilet, cabin with pantry.

Applications in Mumbai

Porta cabins from SAMAN are used across Mumbai for:

  • Site offices: General contractor offices at metro rail, highway, and residential project sites throughout the MMR.
  • Security guard posts: Gated communities in Powai, Andheri, and Kandivali install compact single-room guard cabins at entry points.
  • Labour colony blocks: Construction labour accommodation at large project sites in Thane, Kalyan-Dombivli, and Panvel.
  • Retail kiosks and sales offices: Temporary sales offices at project launch sites and exhibition grounds like the Bandra–Kurla Complex.
  • Equipment and material stores: Lockable site stores at infrastructure project yards along the Coastal Road and Aarey Metro Car Shed stretch.

For buyers across the wider region, we also build the same units for our porta cabin in Pune customers.

MS-frame porta cabins in use at infrastructure project sites across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

Customisation Options

We build to your project's exact specification:

  • Custom room sizes and multi-room configurations
  • Colour choice (standard RAL palette)
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall sleeve cut-out and electrical point)
  • Additional ventilation (exhaust fan point, turbo ventilator)
  • Partition walls within a module
  • Extra doors or windows
  • Plumbing provisions for attached toilet/washroom
  • Stacking for two-storey site offices (structural review required)

Share your floor plan requirement and site conditions with our team. We will confirm specifications, timeline, and pricing at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Mumbai — What Affects the Cost

Porta cabin prices in Mumbai are not fixed — they depend on:

  1. Size: A 10×10 ft cabin costs significantly less than a 10×40 ft block.
  2. Panel choice: PUF panels cost more than plain MS sheets; cement board is mid-range and preferred in coastal zones.
  3. Fit-out level: Basic shell (frame + roof + floor + door) vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, painting, AC provision).
  4. Customisation: Extra partitions, plumbing, or fire-resistant panels add to the base price.
  5. Quantity: Orders for 5 or more cabins typically attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate price for porta cabin in Mumbai, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 or send an enquiry using the form on this page.

Delivery and Installation in Mumbai

We despatch from our Greater Noida facility (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308). Mumbai deliveries are routed via NH-19 / NH-48 on flatbed trucks. Standard transit is 3–5 days.

Factory-to-site delivery — Mumbai and MMR reached in 3–5 transit days.

On arrival, our installation team (or your site team using our manual) sets the cabin on the pre-cast RCC plinth, runs the anchor bolt pattern, fits the panels, and connects the pre-wired electrical board. A two-room cabin is typically ready for occupancy within one day of arrival.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 per despatch. For multiple cabins in a single truck load, confirm the bundled delivery rate at the time of order. We dispatch North-India projects the same way — see our porta cabin delivery in Lucknow.

We do not claim a Mumbai warehouse or local office. Your cabin is manufactured at our factory and delivered directly to your site.

How to Order a Porta Cabin in Mumbai

Getting a cabin to your Mumbai site follows a clear, manufacturer-direct process:

  1. Share your requirement: Tell us the size or floor plan you need, how the cabin will be used — site office, security post, labour accommodation, store, or sales unit — and the exact delivery location within the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. A photo or rough sketch of the site helps us plan access.
  2. Get a firm quotation: Our team confirms the specification, panel choice, fit-out level, build timeline, and price for the unit you approve. Because each cabin is built to specification, the quotation reflects your exact build rather than a stock list.
  3. Confirm and prepare the base: Once the order is placed, fabrication begins at our Greater Noida facility. Meanwhile, ready a level base at your site — a concrete plinth, a pre-cast RCC pad, or firm compacted ground — so the unit can be set without delay.
  4. Delivery and handover: The finished cabin is trucked to Mumbai in 3 to 5 days, positioned on the base, anchor-bolted, and connected to its pre-wired electrical board. A two-room unit is typically ready to use within a day of arrival.

For larger orders, multi-room blocks, or stacked two-storey site offices, share your site conditions early so our team can plan the structural layout and bolt pattern before dispatch and quote an accurate timeline for your project.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Mumbai

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Navi Mumbai and Thane?

Yes. We deliver across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region including Navi Mumbai, Thane, Kalyan-Dombivli, Panvel, and Raigad district project sites. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Mumbai?

Price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out level. A basic 10×10 ft cabin costs less than a fully fitted 10×30 ft module. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for an accurate quote. We do not publish fixed prices because each order is built to specification.

Do I need any permit or NOC for a porta cabin in Mumbai?

Porta cabins are temporary structures. Most project sites use them without a permanent building permit, but you should verify with your local BMC ward office or project approving authority. We provide the cabin with structural dimensions and load data if needed for site approval paperwork.

MS frame or cement-board panels — which is better for Mumbai's coastal climate?

For Mumbai's high humidity and monsoon conditions, cement-board sandwich panels are preferred over standard GI-faced PUF in coastal-proximity zones. MS frames are the same in both options — IS 2062 Grade A, powder-coated. We recommend cement board for sites within 5 km of the sea.

Can I rent a porta cabin in Mumbai instead of buying?

SAMAN is a manufacturer and seller — we do not operate a rental fleet. For long-duration project needs (12 months or more), buying typically costs less than third-party rental rates. Call us to compare on your specific project duration.

Get a Porta Cabin in Mumbai

To get a porta cabin in Mumbai delivered to your site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. You can also send an enquiry using the form below. Our team will respond with specifications, timeline, and a firm quotation for your requirement.

Explore our complete porta cabin lineup for the full range of sizes, configurations, and product specifications.
